Version 37.29 shipped and is on his PC: in the real game, a death now ends the pillager. The ship's full test run passed and the seed 4242 fingerprint held (85/374, 165/593).

**What changed in the game:**
- **Every raid counts:** each raid that ends adds to the living pillager's record: raids, extracts, kills and best haul. The best haul is the same secured value the extracted card shows.
- **A death or a real quit ends the pillager:** it moves to the hall with how it ended (dead or quit), the map, the zone, the killer named on the killed in action card, the $ lost, up to 7 lost items (most valuable first), a copy of what it wore, and its body look. The next generation is born at once.
- **One floor line:** the next time he lands in the Undercroft it says "<name> is gone  pillager <n>", once.
- **Nothing else moves:** cash, stash, guns, lifetime earnings and rank come out exactly as the same death without the lineage. The worn slots are not cleared; job m3c owns that.
- **What changes nothing:** the instant walk-back, simulated raids, the demo and the player 2 window. In two-player only his own death ends his pillager: a revive keeps it, and a host who dies and spectates has died.

**Fixture change:** I changed the test fixture so every check now starts with pillager generation 1 and an empty hall. Without it, an older check (37.19) failed because earlier checks' deaths now end pillagers.

**Pictures:** the killed in action card at 1080p and 4K is unchanged and passed the camera's text check. No camera screen shows the floor right after a death, so that line is proven by the check only, not by a picture. I asked in questions.md for that screen to be added.

**Watch on his next play:** after a death, the floor line shows once, and the stash, cash and guns he kept look the same as before.
